GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 7th 3 Wide with a trail 6 Lengths out Five Wide x Turn Hard Ridden remained 7th to the 200m then Kept Coming Closest on line, Sound Effort - # 3 wide, gave all

Jumped okay, Eased off heels at 1200m & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, blocked Straightening Up until finally getting room to move after switching inside, Made Some Ground to the line being blocked again at 50m # no luck in Straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1200m lost ground when awkwardly placed on heels. Raced in restricted room approaching 1000m and over raced for a short distance thereafter. Held up when round home turn and approaching the 300m was disappointed for a run when there was insufficient room. Continued to be held up for clear running and steadied from heels near the 250m before shifting back to the inside and securing clear run near the 200m. Approaching the 50m was again disappointed for clear run, steadied and obliged to shift back to the inside.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 5th Inside 3 Lengths then 4 Lengths x 800m, Good Pace on, into Clear and asked to go at the 300m Kept Finding Closest on line, 1st faced breeze and was a very worthy winner, this had # enjoyed good trail
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up momentarily entering the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well eased looking to find a spot landed three back fence 5 Lengths (1000m), urged along 500 leading trio got away, this Saved Ground & came to the Outside early Straight , pounced 120 raced away # pace on/ran on
Bit Slow Out Ridden Along Settled Down 4th Inside 3 Lengths 3rd x 500m 2 Lengths clear run home Inside 2nd x 300m run peaked 200m was # No Match 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure from the 400m causing its rider to stop riding and straighten near the 200m, and then continued to lay out for the remainder.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Caught 6 Wide early Soon After 3 Wide 3rd eventually let stride 2nd Outside 1/2 Lengths off leader/winner , Under Pressure x Turn Weakened to the line - faced breeze , slow post race, and thumps = # forget ever ran
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. A post-race vet exam revealed a slow post-race recovery and the thumps. Tnr advised going for a spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 1100m, held together much same to turn then Hooked Out to 2 Lengths 3 Wide , hit Lead 250m, burst clear and bolted away running to the post. [Stewards questioned trainer re above market performance. Trainer advised it had worked well since its last run at Warwick 22/01/2026 where it ran on well, drew a good gate and, with favourable racing conditions, the stable was confident of a forward showing.] # dominant win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: - Stewards spoke with Trainer Mr J Bruce stable representative regarding the above market performance of the gelding. The horse had worked well since its last run at Warwick on the 22 January 2026 where it ran on well over the final stages. It drew a good gate and with favorable racing conditions the stable was confident of a forward showing at today’s meeting

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Drifted Back 3rd last Two Wide 7 Lengths 800m, still well off them getting to Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up , chased home strongly and was not Beaten all that far, blinkers off first time # ran on solidly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 400m, became awkwardly placed on heels and shifted wider. Raced wide for the majority.
